combo_label: Christmas × Perfume & Scent × 20th-Century English Choral Music

entries.clue: Perforated metal pot swung on chains to send holy smoke down the aisle
Man's voice pitched between the highest and the lowest of the male ranges
Handel oratorio whose Hallelujah chorus brings audiences to their feet
Crook-carrying keeper of sheep, watching the flock by night when the good news came
Gustav of the Planets who also gave In the Bleak Midwinter its tune
Soft purple fruit crammed with seeds, dried for winter and sung about in a carol
The smell of rain landing on ground that has been dry for weeks
Corner set left on all afternoon, its big-day schedule ringed in the Radio Times
Intimate place of worship inside a college, castle or hospital
Barrel's curved plank, or the five lines music is written on
Clear sticky roll whose end vanishes just when the presents need covering
Trail a wearer leaves behind in a room, named from the wake of a boat
